proved: The page prints no single grand total, but each category's own SUBTOTALS row states an internal identity three times over: REALIZED GAIN/LOSS + EARNINGS = NET INCOME; BEGINNING + NET INCOME + TRANSFERS = ENDING (separately for principal and earnings); ENDING PRINCIPAL + ENDING EARNINGS = ENDING VALUE; ENDING VALUE + UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS = ENDING MARKET VALUE. Checked all five: Scholarship and Miscellaneous tie exactly on every leg. Conservation ties exactly except the Ending Earnings figure, which had to be pulled from a neighboring line (y=0.581) rather than the subtotal's own row (y=0.579) — treat that one cell as unconfirmed. Library ties exactly once its whole row's ~0.018 rightward x-shift (visible in its column positions, 0.647/0.696/0.746/0.792/0.850/0.903 vs the ~0.629/0.680/0.727/0.786/0.842/0.885 used elsewhere) is accounted for — a rotation/skew effect per rule 13b, not a different layout. Cemetery's earnings/value/market-value chain ties exactly, but its principal roll-forward (Beginning Principal + Transfers of Principal = Ending Principal) is off by exactly $2,000.00 and did NOT prove — most likely an OCR-misread digit in one of the three Cemetery figures, not a column-placement error, but not established.
note: Two things could not be read reliably and are left out rather than guessed. (1) ACCOUNT NUMBER is a real header column (x≈0.080, "ACCOUNT"/"NUMBER") but no data resembling an account number appears anywhere on the page at that x-position for any row, so the column is reported with no values. (2) The ~25 individual fund rows beneath each SUBTOTALS line (Perpetual Care Bequest, C. Allen Headstone, Sale of Cemetery Lots; seven Conservation funds; a dozen Library funds; a dozen Scholarship funds; five Miscellaneous funds) are present but too degraded to place figure-to-column with confidence: several rows carry near-duplicate y-values (e.g. 0.716/0.718, 0.709/0.707, 0.632/0.633/0.635) that appear to interleave two physically adjacent lines; several numeric tokens are not parseable as currency at all ("51502", "9517 41", "3141", "12 i2", "300."); several boxes are scanner artifacts (long runs of "8888888888888"); and at least one fund name is illegible ("CATH-RNE ATONCRRARY"). Rather than assign these to columns by guesswork, only the five category SUBTOTALS rows — the ones whose figures reconcile against each other and so can be checked — are reported. The STABILIZATION FUNDS section heading appears at the very foot of the page (y=0.075) with no rows before the page ends; its table continues on the next page, not shown here.
